name: Disarming Mixture
summary: At Stonewrought Dam, Disarming Mixture is prepared to stop a Seaforium charge from breaking the dam. Chief Engineer Hinderweir makes it to neutralize explosives planted by Dark Iron saboteurs.

sections.title: A Chemical Neutralizer
sections.body: Dark Iron saboteurs planted a heavy Seaforium charge beneath Stonewrought Dam’s foundation. With no Mountaineer support close at hand, Chief Engineer Hinderweir used ingredients named by explosives expert Ashlan Stonesmirk to make the Disarming Mixture. Stirred into the planted powder keg underwater, the solution neutralizes its reactive compounds and leaves the charge fizzled and harmless.

faq.q: What is the Disarming Mixture used for?
faq.answer: The mixture neutralizes a large Seaforium explosive keg planted underwater at Stonewrought Dam’s foundation by Dark Iron insurgents.
Chief Engineer Hinderweir blends the ingredients to create the mixture while overseeing maintenance and defense at Stonewrought Dam.

faq.q: Why was the mixture necessary instead of simply disarming the bomb?
aliases: why use chemicals on the bomb
faq.answer: Dry Seaforium powder is harmless, but wet powder can explode with tremendous force. The mixture neutralizes the reactive powder inside the keg while it remains submerged beneath the dam.

angles.text: For an engineer, the Disarming Mixture shows how chemical neutralization can render a volatile Seaforium charge harmless without setting it off.
As a dwarf, protecting the valleys and lowlands around Stonewrought Dam matters to your people. Applying the neutralizer quickly helps defend them.
